Enable SSH and persist host keys.

## Inputs

No artifact inputs.

## Parameters

| Name                   | Default | Description                                                                                 |
| ---------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `root_authorized_keys` | `""`    | Public authorized_keys entries appended to root's authorized_keys file. Empty adds no keys. |

## Scheduling

| Setting      | Value        |
| ------------ | ------------ |
| Priority     | `80000`      |
| Dependencies | `pkg-update` |

Higher priorities run first within the selected recipe set. Dependencies include
other recipes; their priorities determine execution order.

## Behavior

Installs OpenSSH and a systemd or OpenRC service that preserves SSH host keys
across boots. The optional authorized keys are appended to
/root/.ssh/authorized_keys; the system's SSH configuration still determines
whether root login is allowed.

## Example

For example, add the recipe to a layer derived from a compatible base:

```toml
recipes = ["core/ssh"]
```
